data.title: Creek Waters 2
data.about:
Welcome to Creek Waters 2 by Emaar, a captivating masterpiece where the harmony of refined living and enchanting leisure coalesce, forging an unparalleled waterfront community. 

Nature and luxury intertwine within this haven, inviting residents to embrace moments that will forever linger in their hearts. Unveiling its splendour, Creek Waters 2 by Emaar boasts a lush central park, an oasis of tranquillity where verdant landscapes inspire serenity and introspection. Alongside the water’s edge, mesmerizing marina views with their irresistible allure entice yacht owners to embark on extraordinary voyages. A sanctuary of exclusivity, the prestigious yacht club stands as a testament to indulgence, while the district’s five-star hotels bestow opulent havens where cherished memories are woven.

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Creek Waters 2 occupies a central position within a thriving district. Once fully developed, this area will provide an array of contemporary conveniences and facilities, such as top-tier schools, lifestyle and entertainment hubs, and convenient transportation connections to the wider Dubai region.

  • 10 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 15 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 40 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport
